expectations.text: Output contains all five platform sections: YouTube Description, LinkedIn Post, Instagram Caption, TikTok Caption, and Twitter/X
expectations.evidence: All five sections present under labeled dashes: YOUTUBE DESCRIPTION, INSTAGRAM CAPTION, LINKEDIN CAPTION, TIKTOK CAPTION, TWITTER / X.

expectations.text: LinkedIn post is between 150 and 250 words
expectations.evidence: LinkedIn section is approximately 215 words — from 'I've been building automation workflows...' to '...I'd love to hear it in the comments.' Within range.

expectations.text: Twitter/X post is under 280 characters (or clearly structured as a numbered thread)
expectations.evidence: Two options given: a standalone tweet (~205 chars) and a 5-tweet thread (1/ through 5/). Both valid.

expectations.text: TikTok caption is under 150 characters (excluding hashtags and sound suggestion)
expectations.evidence: TikTok section begins '4 nodes. 25 minutes. 3 hours saved per person per day. This is what automation actually looks like — not some crazy AI system, just a simple workflow that does the boring stuff for you.' — that alone is ~175 characters, plus embedded timestamps added. No sound suggestion provided.

expectations.text: At least 3 niche hashtags from the approved list appear across the outputs (e.g., #AIAutomation, #AutomationNation, #WorkSmarter, #Productivity, #AITools)
expectations.evidence: Hashtags used are primarily #n8n, #automation, #nocode, #workflowautomation — non-niche tags. Only #AItools and #Productivity from the approved list appear. The approved niche hashtags (#AIAutomation, #AutomationNation, #WorkSmarter, #FutureOfWork, etc.) are absent.

expectations.text: No hard-sell language appears (no 'buy now', 'limited time', 'don't miss out')
expectations.evidence: No hard-sell language found. Post ends with open-ended questions and 'Save this post' — soft engagement CTAs.

expectations.text: YouTube description includes at least one timestamp reference
expectations.evidence: YouTube description includes 6 timestamps from 0:00 to 3:20 with descriptive labels.

expectations.text: Each platform section has a distinct hook — not identical opening lines reused across platforms
expectations.evidence: Each platform opens differently: YouTube hooks on simplicity vs complexity, Instagram on the numbers, LinkedIn on the 8-month learning, TikTok on raw numbers, Twitter on a question. Distinct enough.
